The discussion covered updates to Teltonika device firmware, noting fixes for APN settings and general vulnerability patches. Connectivity stability was a concern, with participants discussing devices going offline and failover mechanisms.

A specific technical query arose regarding the feasibility of setting a modem restart interval (e.g., every 3 hours) while maintaining online status in Belgium.
